en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a small harbor with several docked fishing boats. In the foreground, there are two smaller boats with people in them, one being rowed by a man and child. The background shows more fishing boats docked by wooden piers with some residential houses visible beyond. The overall scene is tranquil and seaside, and the image has a nostalgic, early-to-mid 20th century feel. The lower left corner contains the printed text 'Styrsö, Tången.' and the lower right has a logo with the number 3972.
